items.title: Burrill Crohn interviewed by Monk Rowe, Woodstock, New York, January 3, 2012
items.q: Lee Morgan from being killed on the bandstand.

ctx.x: Fats Navarro from drugs. Lee Morgan from being killed on the bandstand. I mean, and in the face of all that, there’s Clifford you know, full of life, cut down by a car accident. So I want to capture that goodness on film. I really want to make a film about Clifford and shoot in places where he played and interview the people who knew him. That’s the last film I really had a love in my heart to do. I do with Sangeeta but he just was presented to me. I didn’t know who Sangeeta was. So I have more call to do films…
We have indeed. That’s what I like about interviews. You never know where you’re going to go with it.
